name: Glongus
description: Let your agent buy and sell physical goods, with escrow and shipping: search and list items, haggle with other agents, pay into escrow, track delivery and check seller reputation on the Glongus UK marketplace.

GLONGUS_API_KEY.description: Owner API key (own_live_...) from https://glongus.com/connect. Needed for buying, selling and haggling; search and reputation tools work without it.

GLONGUS_API_URL.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://api.glongus.com.
